short_17920726.summary: Short's private complaint at being passed over for Paris in favour of Gouverneur Morris: Lafayette's mortification, the French diplomatic committee's wish to refuse Morris, and Short's preferences for a post (the Hague as resident, Spain as plenipotentiary) and for the grades of the American diplomatic establishment.
short_17920726.en:
(f. 0160999) ... the class of people called les intriguants ...

(f. 0161001) I mentioned to you in a former letter how much the Mar fai had been and mortified at this circumstance.

(ff. 0161005-1009) You there are so good as to state to me the precarious footing on which I stand and to desire me to do in this what I chuse, informing you of my wishes that you may cooperate with them. Encouraged by this kind and friendly offer I resume a subject which I had so much repented having formerly importuned you about, namely my wishes as to my own personal advancement. My reasons for not desiring to return to America as yet, and with which you are acquainted, and my being thus launched in the diplomatic career, put me absolutely in the power of government, so that they may do what they please; for the present I am obliged to accept and obey.

carmichael_17880414.summary: A clear letter with five code numbers used as a test of his cypher: Maryland (twice), Massachusetts and the majority on the ratification of the Constitution; the last item (597) stays open. The read share of 0% counts only the five code groups: none has a value attested in another letter (four are context conjectures, 597 is open), and the clear text of the letter is not counted.
carmichael_17880414.en:
Had I been in [Maryland] I should in all probability have been of the sentiment of Paca and the other you mention.
[Maryland] has not acceded to the Constitution, [Massachusetts] has. The [majority] seem pleased with it, what says 597?

pinckney_17930828.summary: Three coded sentences: regiments are to embark shortly on a secret expedition under Sir Charles Grey with Generals Stuart and Dundas, generally thought to be for the West Indies; the number of regiments (447) stays open.
pinckney_17930828.en: 447 regiments are to embark in a short [time?] on a [secret?] expedition. They are to be commanded by Sir Charles Grey with Generals Stuart and [Dunda]s under him. Their destination is generally thought to be for the West Indies.

snip.cap: Pinckney to Jefferson, London, 28 August 1793: the coded passage, “447. 735. 753. 1846. 923. 1490 …” (447 regiments are to embark …), with Jefferson’s pencil “copy so far only”
snip.credit: National Archives and Records Administration, RG 59, Despatches from U.S. Ministers to Great Britain, microfilm M30 roll 2, frame 140, via the NARA catalog

system: Three two-part numerical codes of about 1,700-1,850 groups (words, syllables, letters), groups separated by dots.
